_comment: Synthetic GitHub-forge variant of profiles/fixture, for the pull-request vs merge-request noun check (plan Phase 2). No real site, boards, people or groups - every value here is invented. Its snapshots are generated by scripts/build-fixture.mjs into data/fixture-github/ (gitignored); regenerate them after a clone. Used by the plan's Verification section in place of collected data, which this checkout does not have.

teams.description: Board 701 'Web Platform Scrum'. Carries the cross-board epic PLAT-1 and the cross-board person Dev One; has a board column configuration, so the cumulative-flow panel draws for it.
Board 702 'Logistics Scrum Board'. Also carries epic PLAT-1 and Dev One - the pair the estate rollups exist to reconcile. Has board columns.
Board 704 'Onboarding Scrum'. Deliberately has NO board column configuration, so the flow panel shows its not-computed state rather than a chart.
